description: This file contains functions and logic for setting up and running Gmail webhook integrations, including configuration management, dependency checks, process spawning, and signal handling.

methods.name: runGmailSetup
methods.description: Sets up Gmail webhook configuration, including dependencies, GCP project, Pub/Sub topic, subscription, and updates the configuration file.

methods.name: runGmailService
methods.description: Starts the Gmail webhook service, manages process lifecycle, and handles restart logic on exit.

methods.name: spawnGogServe
methods.description: Spawns the gog process with arguments built from the runtime configuration.

methods.name: startGmailWatch
methods.description: Initiates or restarts the Gmail watch process, with optional fatal error handling.
